ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixels limited to barnacle colonization sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-tone pigmentation across the contiguous area of both lobes. High-contrast white pixel blobs are concentrated in dense clusters at the lateral distal tips and scattered as individual points across the central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at the central base with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude sawtooth irregularities. The trailing edge is characterized by deep, non-uniform vertical indentations and jagged peaks ranging from 5 to 30 pixels in relative depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature of the inner margins sweeping outward, significantly modified by irregular terminal-edge tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacles) on the far-left and far-right edges; scattered individual circular white marks across the dark pigmentation of the inner fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and tissue loss along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, resulting in a tattered, non-linear geometric boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Faint circular 'ghost' rings or halo patterns visible on the right lobe surface, representing former attachment sites of sessile organisms.
